FREELANCE COPYWRITING AGREEMENT

This Freelance Copywriting Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on June 8, 2026 between Northfield Dental Group PLLC ("Client") and the writer named on the signature page ("Writer").

Section 1 - The Work

1.1 Writer will write the text for Client's new website, consisting of a home page, an about page, six service pages and a contact page (the "Copy").
1.2 Writer will deliver a first draft of the Copy by July 6, 2026 and the final Copy by July 27, 2026.
1.3 Client will give Writer its existing brochures, a list of its services and access to two staff members for short interviews within one week of signing.
1.4 The fee includes two rounds of revisions on each page.
1.5 Writer decides how, when and where to do the work, and is an independent contractor, not an employee of Client.

Section 2 - Fees and Payment

2.1 Client will pay Writer a fixed fee of $4,500 for the Copy.
2.2 Client will pay half of the fee on signing and the other half on delivery of the final Copy.
2.3 Writer will invoice by email, and Client will pay each invoice within 14 days of receiving it.
2.4 Extra pages or revisions beyond those in Section 1 are billed at $90 per hour, but only after Client approves an estimate in writing.

Section 3 - Ownership

3.1 Once Client has paid the full fee, Writer assigns to Client the copyright in the final Copy.
3.2 Writer keeps ownership of drafts Client did not use and of Writer's own research notes, outlines and writing methods.
3.3 Writer may show the final Copy in Writer's portfolio after Client's website goes live.

Section 4 - Confidentiality

4.1 Each party will keep confidential any non-public information the other shares for this project and use it only for this project.
4.2 This obligation does not cover information that is public, already known to the receiving party, or lawfully received from someone else.

Section 5 - Term and Termination

5.1 This Agreement begins on signing and ends when Client has paid for the final Copy.
5.2 Either party may end this Agreement for any reason on ten days' written notice by email.
5.3 If either party ends this Agreement early, Client will pay Writer for all work done up to the end date, prorated against the fixed fee.
5.4 This Agreement does not renew.

Section 6 - Other Work

6.1 Writer is free to write for other clients, including other dental practices, during and after this Agreement.

Section 7 - Liability

7.1 Each party is responsible for claims caused by its own breach of this Agreement or its own negligence.
7.2 Each party's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the fee paid or payable under it.

Section 8 - Disputes

8.1 Any dispute between Client and Writer about payment for or performance of the work under this Agreement will be resolved by binding arbitration in the county where Writer lives.
8.2 Before starting any claim, the parties will try in good faith to settle the dispute by talking for at least 14 days.

Section 9 - General Terms

9.1 This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties about the Copy.
9.2 Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and sent by email to the addresses on the signature page.
9.3 If any provision of this Agreement is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions stay in effect.
